title: Lokacin hutu
description: Ten short, simple stories about free time and hobbies in Hausaland: a football match, a romance film, a trip to Yankari, a folk tale, a drama group, a new sports building, a radio programme, an old book, loud music at night and a street race.

lessons.title: Gwiwar Muntari
lessons.summary: Muntari hurts his knee in a football match in Kano and goes to hospital; his team wins, and two weeks later the doctor lets him play again.
lessons.text:
Muntari yana son wasan ƙwallon ƙafa ƙwarai. Bayan aiki a Kano, yana zuwa fili domin ya yi wasa tare da abokansa.

Wata rana akwai babban wasa tsakanin ƙungiyarsu da wata ƙungiya daga Zaria. Kafin wasan, Muntari ya cire rigarsa ta aiki, sannan ya saka rigar ƙungiyarsu.

Abokinsa Faruk ya ce masa, "Allah ya ba mu sa'a!"

"Tabbas za mu yi nasara," Muntari ya ce.

Wasan ya fara. Muntari ya yi gudu ƙwarai, kuma ya ci ƙwallo ɗaya. Mutane da yawa suka yi farin ciki.

Bayan haka, Muntari ya faɗi ƙasa da ƙarfi. Ya ji ciwo ƙwarai a gwiwarsa, kuma bai iya tashi ba.

Faruk ya zo wurinsa da sauri. Ya duba gwiwar Muntari, sai ya ga akwai rauni a kanta. Jini yana fita daga raunin.

"Kada ka damu," Faruk ya ce. "Za mu kai ka asibiti."

Suka kai shi wani asibiti da ke kusa da filin. A asibitin, wata likita ta duba raunin. "Kada ka damu," ta ce. "Raunin ba babba ba ne. Amma kada ka yi wasa har sai bayan mako biyu." Sai ta saka masa magani a kan raunin.

Amma Muntari ya damu. "Me ya faru da wasan?" ya ce wa Faruk.

Da dare, Faruk ya kira shi a waya. "Mun yi nasara!" ya ce. "Mun ci biyu, su kuma sun ci ɗaya. Ƙwallonka ce ta farko."

"Mun yi sa'a!" Muntari ya ce.

Bayan mako biyu, Muntari ya koma asibitin. Likitar ta duba gwiwarsa. "Raunin ya tafi, kuma gwiwarka tana lafiya," ta ce. "Tabbas za ka iya yin wasa yanzu."

Da ya isa gida, Muntari ya cire rigarsa ta aiki, ya saka rigar ƙungiyarsu, sannan ya tafi fili.

Tambayoyi:
Me Muntari yake so ƙwarai?
Yana son wasan ƙwallon ƙafa ƙwarai.
Me Muntari ya saka kafin wasan?
Ya saka rigar ƙungiyarsu.
Ina Muntari ya ji ciwo?
Ya ji ciwo a gwiwarsa.
Ina suka kai shi?
Sun kai shi asibiti.
Ƙungiyar wa ta yi nasara?
Ƙungiyar Muntari ce ta yi nasara.

lessons.title: Fim ɗin soyayya
lessons.summary: Hannatu and her mother Saude watch a romance film at home in Kaduna; the mother knows the actor, and at the end she falls asleep in her chair.
lessons.text:
Hannatu tana zaune a Kaduna tare da mahaifiyarta Saude. Hannatu tana son kallon fim ƙwarai. Kowane dare, bayan ta gama aikin gida, tana zama a kan kujera a ɗakinsu domin ta yi kallo.

Wata rana Saude ta zo ɗakin. "Wane fim ne wannan?" ta ce.

"Fim ɗin soyayya ne," Hannatu ta ce. "Zo ki zauna a kan wannan kujera, mu yi kallo tare."

Saude ta zauna a kan kujera kusa da ita. A cikin fim ɗin, wani mutum mai suna Kamal yana ƙaunar wata mace mai suna Laila. Ƙaunarsa tana da girma, amma ba ya iya yin magana da ita. Saboda haka, ya rubuta mata wasiƙa. A cikin wasiƙar, ya faɗa mata cewa yana ƙaunarta.

Laila ta karanta wasiƙar, sai ta yi dariya. Saude ma ta yi dariya. "Ai ni ma na rubuta wa mahaifinki wasiƙa irin wannan!" ta ce.

"Kina gane mutumin da yake wasa a matsayin Kamal?" Hannatu ta ce.

"Ina gane shi," Saude ta ce. "Ai shi ne ya yi wani fim na soyayya da muka gani a shekarar da ta wuce."

Bayan wani lokaci, Laila ta ajiye wasiƙar a kan kujera. Ta ɗauki waya, ta kira Kamal. "Ni ma ina ƙaunarka," ta ce masa. Suka yi aure, kuma suka zauna lafiya cikin soyayya.

"Ai soyayyarsu tana da kyau!" Hannatu ta ce. Amma Saude ba ta ce komai ba. Hannatu ta duba ta, sai ta gane cewa tana bacci a kan kujera.

"Kina bacci?" Hannatu ta ce.

Saude ta buɗe idonta. "Ba na bacci," ta ce. "Kina gani, ina kallo."

Hannatu ta yi dariya, sannan ta ajiye wayarta. "To, mu tafi mu yi bacci," ta ce.

Tambayoyi:
Me Hannatu take so?
Tana son kallon fim.
Wane fim ne suke kallo?
Fim ɗin soyayya ne.
Me Kamal ya rubuta wa Laila?
Ya rubuta mata wasiƙa.
Ina Laila ta ajiye wasiƙar?
Ta ajiye ta a kan kujera.
Me Saude ta yi a kan kujera?
Ta yi bacci a kan kujera.

lessons.title: Yawo a Yankari
lessons.summary: Aliyu, Zubaida and their daughter Amira travel from Lagos to Yankari in Bauchi, where a park worker shows them the animals and a monkey licks Amira's hand.
lessons.text:
Aliyu da matarsa Zubaida suna zaune a Legas, wani babban birni a kudu. Suna da 'ya ɗaya, Amira, wadda take da shekara 8. Wata rana sun yi shirin zuwa yawo a Yankari, a jihar Bauchi.

"Ina Bauchi take?" Amira ta ce.

"Bauchi tana arewa maso gabas," Aliyu ya ce. "Legas tana kudu, amma Bauchi tana arewa maso gabas."

Suka tafi da mota. Da suka isa Bauchi, rana tana da zafi ƙwarai. Zafin ya kai digiri 40. "A Legas zafin ba ya kai digiri 40!" Zubaida ta ce.

A Yankari akwai dabbobi da yawa. Wani mutum mai suna Malam Zakari ya zo wurinsu. "Aikina shi ne in tsare dabbobin nan," ya ce. "Muna tsare su domin kada mutane su kashe su."

Da farko suka ga wata giwa babba. "Giwa tana da nauyi ƙwarai," Malam Zakari ya ce. "Nauyinta ya fi na mota biyu."

"Nauyinta ya fi na mota biyu?" Amira ta ce. Ta yi mamaki ƙwarai.

Sannan wani ƙaramin biri ya zo kusa da su. Biri ya lasa hannun Amira, sai ta yi dariya. "Biri ya lasa hannuna!" ta ce.

"Kowace dabba halitta ce ta Allah," Malam Zakari ya ce. "Duk dabbobin da kuka gani a nan halittar Allah ne. Shi ya sa muke tsare su."

Bayan haka, suka je wani ruwa mai zafi a cikin Yankari. Ruwan yana da zafi digiri 31. Amira ta saka ƙafarta a cikin ruwan. "Yana da daɗi!" ta ce.

Bayan kwana biyu, suka koma Legas, a kudu. A cikin mota, Amira ta ce, "Ina so mu sake zuwa yawo a arewa maso gabas!"

Tambayoyi:
Ina Aliyu da Zubaida suke zaune?
Suna zaune a Legas, a kudu.
Ina Bauchi take?
Bauchi tana arewa maso gabas.
Zafi ya kai digiri nawa a Bauchi?
Zafin ya kai digiri 40.
Me ya sa Malam Zakari yake tsare dabbobin?
Domin kada mutane su kashe su.
Me biri ya yi wa Amira?
Biri ya lasa hannunta.

lessons.title: Labarin mugun sarki
lessons.summary: In a village near Maradi, grandmother Indo tells the children a tale of a bad king who never shared and his good slave with a bow, who did not forget him in a year of hunger.
lessons.text:
Kaka Indo tana zaune a wani ƙauye kusa da Maradi. Da dare, yara suna son zuwa wurinta domin ta ba su labari. Wata rana Sumayya ta ce, "Kaka, ki ba mu labarin mugun sarki!"

Kaka Indo ta fara:

"A da, akwai wani mugun sarki a wani ƙauye. Sarkin ya haifi 'ya'ya maza bakwai. Yana kuma da bawa ɗaya mai suna Lado. Lado mutum ne mai gaskiya, kuma yana da imani.

"Kowace rana Lado yana zuwa daji da bakansa. Da bakansa yana kashe tsuntsaye da dabbobi, sai ya kawo wa sarki. Amma sarkin mugu ne. Sarki yana ci tare da 'ya'yansa bakwai, ba ya raba wa mutanen ƙauyen ba.

"Lado ya tuna da mutanen ƙauyen da ba su da abinci. Wata rana ya raba abin da ya kawo ga mutanen ƙauyen. Da sarkin ya ji haka, ya ce wa bawan, 'Ka fita daga ƙauyena!'

"Lado ya tafi daji da bakansa. Ya ce, 'Ina da imani. Allah ba zai manta da ni ba.'

"Bayan shekara bakwai, babu ruwan sama, kuma babu abinci a ƙauyen. Sarkin ya zama tsoho, kuma gashin kansa ya yi fari.

"Wata rana, Lado ya dawo daga daji da tsuntsaye da yawa. Ya kawo wa sarkin. Sarkin ya ce, 'Na manta da mutanena, amma kai ba ka manta da ni ba.' Daga wannan rana, sarkin ya daina zama mugu. Kullum yana raba abincinsa ga mutanen ƙauyen."

Yara suka yi dariya. Sumayya ta ce, "Kaka, ba zan manta da wannan labari ba. Kullum zan tuna da Lado."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Kaka Indo take zaune?
Tana zaune a wani ƙauye kusa da Maradi.
'Ya'ya nawa sarkin ya haifa?
Ya haifi 'ya'ya maza bakwai.
Me Lado yake ɗauka zuwa daji?
Yana ɗaukar bakansa.
Me ya sa sarkin ya ce wa Lado ya fita daga ƙauyen?
Domin Lado ya raba abin da ya kawo ga mutanen ƙauyen.
Me ya faru da gashin sarkin?
Gashin kansa ya yi fari.

lessons.title: Ƙungiyar wasan kwaikwayo
lessons.summary: Nazifi's drama group in Zaria makes him its leader; he organises a play for a festival, notices that Bara'atu has no part and gives her one, and the play is a success.
lessons.text:
Nazifi yana cikin wata ƙungiyar wasan kwaikwayo a Zaria. Burinsa shi ne ya zama babban ɗan wasan kwaikwayo a Najeriya.

Wata rana shugaban ƙungiyar, Malam Tukur, ya kira 'yan ƙungiyar. "Na zama tsoho," ya ce. "Zan bar muƙamina na shugaba. Wane ne zai ɗauki wannan muƙami?"

Suka yi tattaunawa mai tsawo. Bayan tattaunawar, sai suka zaɓi Nazifi ya ɗauki muƙamin shugaba.

"Zan yi muku aiki mai kyau," Nazifi ya ce.

Malam Tukur ya ce, "Ka yi jagoranci mai kyau. Jagoranci yana da wuya, amma za ka iya."

Nazifi ya ce, "Ina so mu tsara wani wasa domin bikin gidan sarki." Suka fara tsara wasan tare. Nazifi ya rubuta jerin sunayen 'yan wasa da aikin kowane ɗayansu.

Bayan kwana biyu, Nazifi ya lura cewa wata 'yar ƙungiyar mai suna Bara'atu tana zaune ita kaɗai. Ya duba jerin sunayen, sai ya lura cewa sunanta ba ya ciki. Ya je wurinta.

"Ba ni da aiki a wasan," Bara'atu ta ce. "Kowa yana taimakawa, amma ni ban yi komai ba."

Sai Nazifi ya rubuta sunanta a cikin jerin. "Za ki yi wasa a matsayin uwar sarki," ya ce.

Bara'atu ta yi farin ciki. Daga wannan rana, ita ma tana taimakawa a kowane aiki.

Ranar bikin ta zo. Shirinsu ya zama cikakke. Mutane da yawa suka zo kallon wasan, kuma suka ji daɗinsa ƙwarai. Bayan wasan, Malam Tukur ya ce wa ƙungiyar, "Abin da kuke yi yana da kyau. Jagorancin Nazifi cikakken jagoranci ne."

Nazifi ya ce, "Na gode muku. Ku ne kuke yin wannan aiki, ba ni kaɗai ba."

Tambayoyi:
Me Nazifi yake so ya zama?
Burinsa shi ne ya zama babban ɗan wasan kwaikwayo.
Wane muƙami Nazifi ya ɗauka?
Ya ɗauki muƙamin shugaba.
Me Nazifi ya rubuta?
Ya rubuta jerin sunayen 'yan wasa.
Me Nazifi ya lura da shi?
Ya lura cewa sunan Bara'atu ba ya cikin jerin.
Wane aiki Bara'atu ta yi a wasan?
Ta yi wasa a matsayin uwar sarki.

lessons.title: Sabon gini a Abuja
lessons.summary: In Abuja the federal government opens a new sports building; the minister gives a speech about his promise, and Jamilu plays the first basketball game in it.
lessons.text:
Jamilu yana zaune a Abuja, babban birnin tarayya. Yana son wasan ƙwallon kwando ƙwarai, amma a da babu wurin wasa mai kyau kusa da gidansa.

Shekara biyu da suka wuce, ministan wasanni ya yi alƙawari cewa gwamnatin tarayya za ta gina wani sabon gini domin wasa a Abuja. Mutane da yawa ba su yarda da alƙawarinsa ba.

Amma gwamnati ta aiwatar da shirin. Ta kashe naira miliyan ɗari biyar wajen wannan gini. Yanzu aikin ginin ya ƙare. Ginin yana da sassa uku: sashin ƙwallon ƙafa, sashin ƙwallon kwando, da sashin gudu.

Ranar buɗe ginin muhimmiyar rana ce. Mutane da yawa suka zo, kuma Jamilu yana cikinsu. Minista ya tsaya a gaban mutane ya yi jawabi.

A cikin jawabinsa, minista ya ce, "Shekara biyu da suka wuce, na yi muku alƙawari. Yau mun aiwatar da wannan alƙawari. Wasa yana da mahimmanci ga matasa. Muna so mu inganta wasa a ƙasar nan."

Ya ce kuma, "Wannan muhimmin gini ne. Gwamnatin tarayya ta kashe miliyan ɗari biyar domin ta inganta rayuwar matasa." Mutane suka yi farin ciki bayan jawabinsa.

Bayan jawabin, minista ya je sashin ƙwallon kwando. Jamilu da abokansa suna can, kuma suna shirin yin wasa na farko a sabon ginin.

"Me kuke so a wannan sashi?" minista ya ce wa Jamilu.

"Muna so mu inganta wasanmu," Jamilu ya ce. "Wannan wuri yana da mahimmanci ƙwarai."

Sai suka fara wasa. Minista ya zauna yana kallonsu. Ƙungiyar Jamilu ta yi nasara. Jamilu ya ce wa abokansa, "Yau rana ce muhimmiya a rayuwarmu."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Jamilu yake zaune?
Yana zaune a Abuja, babban birnin tarayya.
Wane alƙawari minista ya yi?
Ya yi alƙawari cewa gwamnatin tarayya za ta gina sabon gini domin wasa.
Nawa gwamnati ta kashe wajen ginin?
Ta kashe naira miliyan ɗari biyar.
Ginin yana da sassa nawa?
Yana da sassa uku.
Me minista ya ce game da wasa?
Ya ce wasa yana da mahimmanci ga matasa.

lessons.title: Shirin hutu a tasha
lessons.summary: Lukman's radio programme in Katsina asks what free time means; the scholar Rahma explains her research on hobbies and worry, and a teacher sends a message about his own life.
lessons.text:
Lukman yana aiki a wata tashar rediyo a Katsina. Kowane mako yana da wani shiri dangane da lokacin hutu. A cikin shirin yana magana da masana, kuma mutane suna rubuta masa saƙo a waya.

A wannan mako, Malama Rahma ta zo tashar. Tana cikin masana a jami'a, kuma ta yi nazari dangane da abin da mutane suke yi idan ba sa aiki.

"Malama, ki faɗa mana ma'anar hutu," Lukman ya ce.

"Ma'anar hutu ita ce lokacin da mutum ba ya aiki, kuma yana yin abin da yake so," Rahma ta ce.

"Me nazarinki ya nuna?" Lukman ya ce.

"Nazarina ya nuna cewa akwai alaƙa tsakanin hutu da lafiya," ta ce. "Mutane da yawa suna fama da damuwa saboda aiki. Amma waɗanda suke yin abin da suke so bayan aiki ba sa fama da damuwa sosai. Sauran masana ma sun yarda da wannan."

Sai Lukman ya karanta saƙon wani malami. "Ina da saƙo gare ki, Malama," ya karanta. "Ina fuskantar matsaloli da yawa a aikina. Amma idan na gama aiki, ina buga ƙwallo tare da yarana. Wannan yana taimaka min ƙwarai."

"Kowa yana fuskantar matsaloli," Rahma ta ce. "Amma idan muna yin abin da muke so, muna samun ƙarfin fuskantar su."

Lukman ya ce, "Tasharmu tana so ta yaɗa ilimi ga kowa. Muna yaɗa abin da masana suka gano, domin mutane su yi rayuwa mai kyau."

A ƙarshen shirin, Lukman ya ce, "Ina da saƙo gare ku, mutanen Katsina: ku yi hutu!"

Tambayoyi:
Ina Lukman yake aiki?
Yana aiki a wata tashar rediyo a Katsina.
Malama Rahma ta yi nazari dangane da me?
Ta yi nazari dangane da abin da mutane suke yi idan ba sa aiki.
Me nazarinta ya nuna?
Ya nuna cewa akwai alaƙa tsakanin hutu da lafiya.
Me malamin yake fuskanta a aikinsa?
Yana fuskantar matsaloli da yawa a aikinsa.
Me tashar take so ta yaɗa?
Tana so ta yaɗa ilimi ga kowa.

lessons.title: Littafin ƙarni
lessons.summary: Ja'afar, a clothes seller in Kano, collects old things; he buys a book two centuries old at the market, refuses to sell it, and lends it to a museum.
lessons.text:
Ja'afar yana zaune a Kano. Sana'arsa ita ce sayar da riguna a kasuwa. Amma idan ba ya aiki, yana son tara tsofaffin kaya.

Ja'afar ya mallaki tsofaffin kaya da yawa: tsofaffin littattafai, tsofaffin kuɗi da tsofaffin kujeru. Dukkanin kayansa yana ajiye su a wani ɗaki a gidansa.

Wata rana Ja'afar ya ga wani tsohon littafi a hannun wani mutum a kasuwa. "Littafin nan ya yi shekara nawa?" ya ce.

"Ya yi ƙarni biyu," mutumin ya ce. "An rubuta shi a Kano ƙarni biyu da suka wuce."

"Nawa za ka sayar da shi?" Ja'afar ya ce.

"Zan sayar da shi dubu goma," mutumin ya ce. Ja'afar ya biya kuɗin, sai ya saya. Ya kai littafin gida, ya ajiye shi tare da sauran kayansa.

Bayan wata ɗaya, wani mutum daga gidan tarihi ya zo wurin Ja'afar. "Na ji cewa ka sayi wani littafi na ƙarni biyu," ya ce. "Littafin yana da daraja ƙwarai. Zan biya dubu ɗari a kansa."

"Ba zan sayar da shi ba," Ja'afar ya ce. "Darajarsa tana cikin tarihinsa, ba cikin kuɗi ba."

Mutumin ya yi tunani, sannan ya ce, "To, ka ba mu shi mu ajiye a gidan tarihi na wani lokaci. Duka mutanen Kano za su ga littafin."

Ja'afar ya yarda. "Ku karɓa," ya ce. "Amma littafin nawa ne."

Mutumin ya karɓa da farin ciki. Yanzu littafin yana gidan tarihi, kuma duka mutanen Kano suna zuwa su gani. A kusa da shi akwai rubutu: "Littafin ƙarni biyu. Ja'afar ne ya mallake shi." Dukkanin mutanen da suka zo suna son littafin.

Tambayoyi:
Ja'afar yana sayar da me a kasuwa?
Yana sayar da riguna a kasuwa. Wannan ita ce sana'arsa.
Littafin ya yi ƙarni nawa?
Ya yi ƙarni biyu.
Nawa Ja'afar ya biya?
Ya biya dubu goma.
Me ya sa Ja'afar bai sayar da littafin ba?
Domin darajarsa tana cikin tarihinsa, ba cikin kuɗi ba.
Ina littafin yake yanzu?
Yana gidan tarihi.

lessons.title: Waƙa da dare
lessons.summary: Dalhatu in Jos plays loud music every night; his neighbour Fiddausi, whose little son cannot sleep, complains, and an old man settles the quarrel without going to court.
lessons.text:
Dalhatu yana zaune a Jos. Yana son waƙa ƙwarai. Kowane dare, bayan ya dawo daga aiki, yana jin waƙa da ƙarfi a gidansa.

Kusa da gidansa akwai gidan wata mata mai suna Fiddausi. Tana da ƙaramin ɗa, kuma kullum tana goyon ɗanta a bayanta. Da dare, ɗanta ba ya iya bacci saboda waƙar Dalhatu.

Wata rana da dare, Fiddausi ta zo gidan Dalhatu. Tana goyon ɗanta, kuma yaron yana kuka.

"Yaushe za ka daina wannan waƙa?" ta ce. "Yaron ba ya iya bacci!"

"Wannan gidana ne," Dalhatu ya ce. "Ina da haƙƙin jin waƙa a gidana."

"Mu ma muna da haƙƙin bacci!" Fiddausi ta ce.

Rikici ya fara tsakanin Dalhatu da Fiddausi. Mijin Fiddausi ya zo ya ce, "Idan ba ka daina ba, za mu kai ka gaban shari'a."

"Ku kai ni shari'a!" Dalhatu ya ce. "Ba wanda zai tilasta min in daina waƙa."

Sai wani tsoho mai suna Malam Habibu ya fito daga gidansa. "Ku yi haƙuri," ya ce. "Ba sai kun je shari'a ba. Rikici ba shi da amfani."

Ya ce wa Dalhatu, "Ba zan tilasta maka ka daina waƙa ba. Kana da haƙƙi. Amma lallai ka rage ƙarfin waƙar da dare. Fiddausi ma tana da haƙƙi."

Ya ce wa Fiddausi, "Ke ma ki yi haƙuri."

Dalhatu ya yi tunani. "Yaushe ɗanki yake bacci?" ya ce.

"Ƙarfe 9 na dare," Fiddausi ta ce.

"To, lallai daga yau zan rage ƙarfin waƙa kafin ƙarfe 9," Dalhatu ya ce. "Ki yi haƙuri."

Daga wannan rana babu rikici. Ɗan Fiddausi yana bacci, kuma Dalhatu yana jin waƙarsa a hankali.

Tambayoyi:
Me Dalhatu yake so?
Yana son waƙa ƙwarai.
Me ya sa ɗan Fiddausi ba ya iya bacci?
Saboda waƙar Dalhatu.
Me mijin Fiddausi ya ce zai yi?
Ya ce za su kai Dalhatu gaban shari'a.
Me Malam Habibu ya ce wa Dalhatu?
Ya ce lallai ya rage ƙarfin waƙar da dare.
Yaushe ɗan Fiddausi yake bacci?
Yana bacci ƙarfe 9 na dare.

lessons.title: Gasar gudu a titi
lessons.summary: Husaina runs a street race in Kaduna; another runner pushes her in her lane and she falls, but she gets up, finishes first and receives the cup from the governor.
lessons.text:
Husaina tana son gudu ƙwarai. Kowace rana tana gudu a titin da ke kusa da gidansu a Kaduna.

Wata rana ta ji cewa za a yi gasar gudu a titunan Kaduna. Wadda ta yi nasara za ta karɓi kofi daga gwamna. Husaina ta ce wa mahaifinta, "Ina so in karɓi wannan kofi!"

Ranar gasar, mata 30 suka zo. Kowace mace tana da layinta a titi. Layin Husaina shi ne layi na huɗu.

Gasar ta fara. Husaina ta yi gudu da sauri a cikin layinta. Amma wata mace daga layi na biyar ta shigo layin Husaina, sai ta tura ta. Husaina ta faɗi a kan titi.

Amma Husaina ta tashi da sauri. Ta koma layinta, ta ci gaba da gudu. Ta wuce mace ɗaya, sannan ta wuce wata. A ƙarshen titi, ita ce ta fara isa.

Masu shirya gasar sun ga abin da ya faru. Suka ce, "Wadda ta tura Husaina ta bar layinta. Ba za ta samu komai ba."

Sai gwamna ya zo. Ya miƙa wa Husaina kofi. Ta karɓi kofin da hannu biyu. "Na gode," ta ce.

Gwamna ya yi mata yabo a gaban mutane. "Husaina ta faɗi, amma ta tashi ta ci gaba," ya ce. Mutane da yawa suka yi mata yabo.

Mahaifinta ya zo wurinta. Shi ma ya yi mata yabo.

Husaina ta miƙa masa kofin. "Baba, kai ma ka karɓi kofin," ta ce. "Kai ne ka koya min gudu."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Husaina take gudu kowace rana?
Tana gudu a titin da ke kusa da gidansu.
Layin Husaina shi ne layi na nawa?
Layi na huɗu ne.
Me ya faru da Husaina a gasar?
Wata mace ta tura ta, sai ta faɗi a kan titi.
Wa ya miƙa wa Husaina kofi?
Gwamna ne ya miƙa mata kofi.
Me Husaina ta ce wa mahaifinta?
Ta ce, "Kai ma ka karɓi kofin."
